checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Same pose, face, hoodie, tail and proportions.

must.item: Retains orange hoodie and friendly look
must.why: Hoodie is still orange, with the smile intact.

must.item: Full body including ears and feet visible
must.why: Ears to feet all in frame.

must.item: Pink/teal gradients and retro vaporwave treatment
must.why: Pink-to-teal sky, striped sun, grid floor, neon rim light.

must.item: One square image with no added text

faults.what: Palm tree silhouette is missing, although it was part of the reference look; only a small dark fragment of feathery shape shows near the fox's left side.
Pants turned teal-green and the tail and ears are tinted, so the fox's colours drifted from the original.
The sun is mostly hidden behind the head and has weak stripes.

summary: The fox is faithfully restyled in neon pink and teal with a sun and grid floor, full body and no text, but the palm tree is missing and only a stray fragment of it shows.
